# Mason Koski Real Estate

> Mason Koski is an Atlanta-born REALTOR® with Compass, helping home buyers and sellers across metro Atlanta, with particular depth in intown neighborhoods. She grew up in Decatur, lives in Virginia-Highland, and graduated magna cum laude from the University of Georgia.

## Neighborhoods served
Virginia-Highland, Midtown, Decatur, Old Fourth Ward, Inman Park, Kirkwood, Smyrna, Buckhead, Alpharetta — and metro Atlanta broadly.

## Services
- Buyer representation: pre-approval guidance, a search built around the buyer's criteria, private and off-market showings, offer strategy
- Seller representation: pricing from real comparable sales, marketing, negotiation
